tenderSchedule.title: CEE/TZ/KLB/SEE/AEE-3/2026-27/Capacitor unit Call-2
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Design, Manufacture, Testing and Supply of 110kV and 11kV class of various ratings of Capacitor Units with internal fuses, terminal connectors required to various substations coming under Kalaburagi Operation Zone, Conforming to our Technical Specifications. F.O.R.D at Store/Site basis, including insurance and transportation and un-loading Call-2
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Kalburgi

tenderAddress.blockNumber: O/o the Chief Engineer Electy., Operations Zone, KPTCL, Sedam Road, Kalaburagi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer shall deposit, as part of his tender, Earnest Money Deposit/Bid Security (EMD) for Rs. 1,31,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Eleven Thousand Only) through Karnataka Public Procurement portal by any of the modes specified in KPP Portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied at least 80% (40% in respect of Micro & small enterprises)of quantity of material/equipment in any one of the last 3 years (2 years for Micro & small enterprises)specified in the present enquiry or higher ratings to State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities/ PSUs (Bidders shall have to upload the supporting documents such as Purchase order copies/order completion certificates/ performance certificates.

The Bidder shall furnish the performance certificates for at least 80% (40% in respect of Micro & small enterprises)of quantity of material/equipment specified in the present enquiry or higher ratings, issued by State /Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities/PSUs. The issuing officer of performance certificates shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. The performance certificate shall indicate the rating of Tendered material/equipment, make, name of the PSUs/sub-station/Generating Station where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that the Tendered material/equipment specified in the present enquiry were in successful operation for at least a minimum period of Two years as on the date of bid opening.

Type tested various ratings of Capacitor Units shall be offered. The type test reports shall be furnished for each rating called for in the bid. The Bidder shall furnish Type Test Certificates not older than Seven years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type tests on various ratings of Capacitor Units for each rating specified in the bid as per the relevant IS/IEC standards. In case the type test reports furnished for various ratings of Capacitor Units specified in Bid are older than 7 years or type test reports are furnished, then the bidder shall give an undertaking agreeing to conduct all type tests on various ratings of Capacitor Units for each rating specified in the bid as per the relevant IS/IEC standards, before commencement of supplies, if order is placed on the firm without affecting the Delivery Schedule and at no extra cost to KPTCL.

The Average annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer for best three years out of last preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) should not be less than the Amount put to tender i.eRs. 131.00Lakhs. However, it shall be Rs. 66.00 Lakhs in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises.

The liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank and Term deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/ scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender i.e Rs. 33.00 Lakhs. However it shall be Rs. 17.00 Lakhs in respect of Micro and small Enterprise.
The Bidder should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration with GSTIN number. (Bidder shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration.)

The Bidder shall be a manufacturer or /authorized supplier of reputed manufacturing firm and should have a minimum experience of 5 years in designing, manufacturing, testing of equipments/materials of similar rating capacity to the ones specified and being offered.(Bidder shall upload the supporting documents such as Purchase Order Copies/Performance certificate/Order completion reports). OR The bidder should be approved vendor from the KPTCL.
Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer/Bidder-As per clause No. A (3) i of NIT

Record of poor performance: The Tenderer will be disqualified if they have a record of poor performance against KPTCL orders such as abandoning the contract, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion of contract, if the failure rate of the equipment/materials supplied to KPTCL (either through direct orders or through EPC Contractors) placed in the preceding 5 years is more than 10% of the quantities of capacitor cells supplied.

The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.

The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment/Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids.

Litigation History: The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid

The Tenderer shall upload the Power of Attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500/- non-judicial stamp paper. Further Power of Attorney shall be sent in original to Chief Engineer Electy., Transmission(Operation)Zone, KPTCL, Kalaburagiso as to reach after the last submission date & on or before the date & time of opening Techno commercial Bids.
